reuse.why: Edits the shared getScheduledAmount that all schedule consumers call, but keeps an inline 0.075 tolerance instead of the existing getApproxNumberThreshold and leaves the parallel getExpectedScheduleAmount in server/api-models.ts on the old rule.

duplication.why: The diff itself adds no duplicated logic and even simplifies the range branch to Math.min; the pre-existing copy in api-models.ts is untouched rather than consolidated.

placement.why: The rule change lands in shared/schedules.ts, the module that defines the expected schedule amount.

scope.why: Only the rule and its test table change.

maintainability.why: The core definition is clean, but the API model's own copy of the rule now silently disagrees with it, which a maintainer would have to discover.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The diff routes the change through getScheduledAmount; the pre-existing getExpectedScheduleAmount in server/api-models.ts (which bypasses it) is not touched by the diff.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic is introduced by the diff.
